time-tracker: Time tracking for client and project work billed by the hour. It covers a running work timer, logging hours after the fact, per-project hourly rates, daily and weekly totals against a weekly hours goal, timesheets and CSV exports for a bookkeeper, and turning unbilled hours into invoice lines so the same hours are never billed twice. Entries are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier reads only the last 7 days of history; a Pro license opens the full history.
timer-tracking: Time tracking for client and project work billed by the hour. It covers a running work timer, logging hours after the fact, per-project hourly rates, daily and weekly totals against a weekly hours goal, timesheets and CSV exports for a bookkeeper, and turning unbilled hours into invoice lines so the same hours are never billed twice. Entries are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier reads only the last 7 days of history; a Pro license opens the full history.
price-tracker: Price tracking for products in online shops. It covers reading a product page's current price, watching items over time with an optional target price, each item's price history, prices recorded by hand where a shop blocks automated reading, and whether anything watched got cheaper. Product pages are read by McpStamp's hosted service and watched items are stored per user account; stored prices are only as current as the last refresh. The free tier allows 3 watched items and the last 30 observations per item.
prices-deal: Price tracking for products in online shops. It covers reading a product page's current price, watching items over time with an optional target price, each item's price history, prices recorded by hand where a shop blocks automated reading, and whether anything watched got cheaper. Product pages are read by McpStamp's hosted service and watched items are stored per user account; stored prices are only as current as the last refresh. The free tier allows 3 watched items and the last 30 observations per item.
invoice: Client invoicing. It covers the business profile printed on documents (name, address, VAT id, bank details and defaults), a client list, numbered invoices with VAT, invoices billed from hours, payment recording, A4 PDF invoices and unpaid invoices past their due date. The business profile is shared with the other McpStamp servers that print documents. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier allows 3 invoices a month and adds a credit line to PDFs; Pro renders PDFs unbranded with a logo.
expense-tracker: Business expense tracking with VAT. It covers expenses with their net and VAT split, merchant-to-category rules, default VAT rate and currency, mileage claims, totals by category, project, month or merchant, exports as CSV, XLSX or JSON, and rebilling billable project expenses onto client invoices. Expenses are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The hosted service has no file system, so receipt files cannot be attached; a receipt reference goes in the expense note. The free tier reads the last 30 days of expenses.
spreadsheet: Reading, analysing and writing spreadsheet data in XLSX, CSV, TSV and JSON. It covers sheet and column overviews, reading rows, filtering, grouping and aggregating, column statistics, searching cells, computed columns, writing rows and converting between formats. McpStamp's hosted service has no file system, so data arrives as CSV text, a base64 XLSX upload or a public URL, is kept per user account up to 2 MB, and written files come back as download links valid for one hour. The free tier writes up to 500 rows per file.
currency: Currency rates and conversion based on the European Central Bank daily reference rates. It covers the latest rates against any base currency, converting amounts today or on a past date, one amount in several currencies on the same rate date, historical rates for a currency pair, and FX rates for invoices and expense rebills that span currencies. Only currencies in the ECB daily set are available. Rates are cached on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier covers a 90-day history window.
timezone: Time zone work for people and teams in different places. It covers the current time in cities, countries or IANA zones, moving a time between zones, shared working hours across places, ranked meeting slots, daylight-saving changes, business-day counts that exclude weekends but have no holiday calendar, saved contacts with their zones and working hours, and .ics meeting invites. Contacts are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service, and the user's own zone comes from the shared business profile. The free tier allows 5 contacts and 3 invites a month.
docx: Word document creation and reading. It covers .docx files from structured sections or markdown, text extraction from existing documents, printable HTML versions, {{placeholder}} templates, and client proposals and freelance service agreements built from the shared business profile. Agreements are template skeletons for a lawyer to review, not legal advice. McpStamp's hosted service has no file system, so existing documents arrive as base64 uploads or public URLs, are kept per user account, and written files come back as one-hour download links. The free tier allows 3 proposals or agreements a month.
resume: Resume and cover letter writing from one stored CV profile. It covers contact details, summary, skills, roles, education, certifications and languages, resumes as .docx, markdown or printable HTML within a page budget, reading an existing .docx resume, one-page cover letters, and keyword gap analysis against a job posting that only reorders facts the user already stated. McpStamp's hosted service has no file system, so existing documents arrive as base64 uploads or public URLs and are kept per user account. The free tier allows 3 cover letters a month.
recurring: Recurring invoicing for clients billed on a repeating cadence. It covers repeating invoice schedules with a client, line items, cadence and start and end dates, pausing, resuming or skipping periods, what falls due soon, creating the due invoices and their PDFs in the invoice server, a per-schedule audit log and expected revenue per month. Schedules are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier allows 3 active schedules and a 3-month revenue outlook; the audit log needs Pro, and Pro extends the outlook to 120 months.
clauses: A personal library of reusable contract and proposal clauses. It covers saving, editing and searching clauses by category, tags and jurisdiction, importing and exporting the library, the {{variables}} a selection of clauses needs, and contracts assembled as .docx or markdown where a missing variable stays a bracketed prompt rather than an invented value. The library is stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier holds 10 of the user's clauses and 8 clauses per contract; Pro adds version history, JSON import and export, and tag filtering.
pdf: Work on existing PDF files. It covers page counts, sizes and metadata, merging, splitting, extracting, rotating and reordering pages, PAID or DRAFT stamps, footers with the business name and VAT id from the shared business profile, and best-effort text extraction without OCR. Inputs are never modified. McpStamp's hosted service has no file system, so PDFs arrive as base64 uploads or public URLs, are kept per user account, and results come back as one-hour download links. The free tier allows 5 files per merge and files up to 30 pages.
calendar: Calendar analysis over imported .ics exports from Google, Apple or Outlook. It covers events in a date window with recurring events expanded, event search, busy blocks and free windows inside working hours, double bookings, the next upcoming event, chosen events written to a new .ics file, and past meetings turned into billable time entries. Imported calendars are copies stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service; the user's own calendar is never changed. The free tier holds 2 calendars and a 31-day window; Pro adds public feed URLs.
kanban: Kanban task tracking across project boards. It covers tasks with priority, due dates, estimates, tags and notes on per-project boards with their own columns, moving and completing tasks, search across projects, tasks past their due date, minutes worked against estimates, links from tasks to the time tracker, and a weekly done-versus-planned review. Tasks are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier allows 3 boards and 200 open tasks; custom columns and reviews of past weeks need Pro.
image: Image editing for PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF and TIFF files. It covers size and format details, resizing single images or batches, format conversion, compression, cropping, thumbnails, stripping EXIF, GPS and other metadata, and dominant colours. McpStamp's hosted service has no file system, so images arrive as base64 uploads or public URLs, are kept per user account, and results come back as one-hour download links; text watermarks are not available here. The free tier handles sources up to 4 megapixels and 5 files per batch.
bank-statement: Bank transaction analysis from CSV bank exports. It covers importing statements, searching transactions, categorising them by rules or one by one, spending and income totals by category, month, account or counterparty, matching bank debits to recorded expenses, subscriptions and recurring charges, and CSV or JSON exports. McpStamp's hosted service has no file system, so exports arrive as text, base64 uploads or public URLs; PDF statements are refused. Transactions are stored per user account. The free tier allows 5 category rules and shorter date windows.
quotes: Price quotes for clients, from draft to decision. It covers quotes with line items, VAT, discount and validity date, revisions while a quote is open, plain-text versions for email, A4 PDF quotes, acceptance or decline with a reason, accepted quotes turned into invoices in the invoice server, and pipeline totals with a win rate. Currency, VAT and issuer details come from the shared business profile. Quotes are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier allows 5 open quotes and current-year totals; PDF quotes need Pro.
barcode: QR code and barcode generation. It covers QR codes for text or URLs, WiFi network access, vCard contacts and SEPA euro payments, payment codes for invoices, linear barcodes (Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A) with check digits, and a register of generated codes. Contact and payment codes default to the name, IBAN and contact details in the shared business profile. The register is stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier allows 20 codes a month, one per request; PNG QR codes and bulk generation need Pro.
zip: Zip archive handling. It covers new archives from uploaded files, archive contents with safety flags for path traversal, symlinks, encryption, duplicate names and zip bombs, extraction that refuses unsafe entries, adding files to an existing archive, reading one text entry inline, and a history of created archives. McpStamp's hosted service has no file system, so files arrive as base64 uploads, text or public URLs, are kept per user account, and results come back as one-hour download links. The free tier allows 20 archives a month.
billing-docs: Credit notes and purchase orders. It covers crediting all or part of an issued invoice with VAT reversed at the invoice's own rates, raising purchase orders to suppliers with delivery dates, recording full or partial deliveries, plain-text and A4 PDF versions, and totals of credited money and late orders. Currency, VAT and buyer details come from the shared business profile. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier allows 5 credit notes and 5 purchase orders a month; PDFs and the totals need Pro.
credit-note: Credit notes and purchase orders. It covers crediting all or part of an issued invoice with VAT reversed at the invoice's own rates, raising purchase orders to suppliers with delivery dates, recording full or partial deliveries, plain-text and A4 PDF versions, and totals of credited money and late orders. Currency, VAT and buyer details come from the shared business profile. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier allows 5 credit notes and 5 purchase orders a month; PDFs and the totals need Pro.
deposits: Client deposit and retainer tracking. It covers security or retainer deposits received, applying part of a held deposit to an invoice as a payment in the invoice server, refunds, balances held per client and currency, deposit statements as plain text or A4 PDF, and deposits held for a long time. Amounts are minor units and are never added across currencies. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier has a monthly deposit limit; PDF statements and the whole-book view need Pro.
per-diem: Travel per diem allowances. It covers bundled daily allowance rates with their authority, source and effective date, a trip's allowance with partial days and meal deductions, saved trips with the traveller taken from the shared business profile, and saved trips turned into expense entries for the expense tracker. Saved trips are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. Rate lookups and calculations are free and unlimited; the free tier saves 5 trips a month, and expense export and monthly totals need Pro.
asset-register: A fixed asset register with depreciation. It covers assets with rate, useful life and convention from a bundled tax table, net book value at any date, depreciation schedules per year or month, monthly depreciation journals with expense entries, disposals with their gain or loss, and a yearly register summary. Amounts are whole minor units. The register is stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier holds ten assets; journals and the yearly summary need Pro.
statement-of-account: Statements of account and receivables follow-up for clients. It covers a client's statement for a period with opening and closing balances, invoices, payments, applied deposits and credit notes, ageing of open invoices, statements as plain text or A4 PDF, payment chasers at friendly, firm or final level, and receivables across all clients. Figures come from the invoices, credit notes and deposits in the user's account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier allows 5 statements a month; PDFs, final demands and the all-client view need Pro.
cash-book: A double-entry cash book derived from the user's other McpStamp records. It covers a period's ledger in one currency built from invoices, credit notes, deposits, expenses, bank transactions and assets, proof that debits equal credits, ledger lines, month close with unposted items and bank reconciliation, and movement and balance per account. Source records are read, never changed. Built periods are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier builds 3 periods a month; month close, CSV export and per-account totals need Pro.
amortization: Loan and lease amortization. It covers loans or leases with principal, fees, nominal rate and balloon, the level payment and effective annual rate, period-by-period schedules of interest and principal, the cost of settling or overpaying early, journal entries for payments, and what is owed across all loans. Amounts are whole minor units and rates are in basis points. Loans are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier holds 3 agreements; early settlement, journals and the debt summary need Pro.
petty-cash: Petty cash management on the imprest system. It covers opening a float, cash top-ups, numbered vouchers paid out, counting the cash against the expected balance, the replenishment amount with expense entries and double entry, and the state of each float with its over and short history. Amounts are whole minor units. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier allows one float and 20 vouchers a month; replenishment and float summaries need Pro.
work-order: Work orders for jobs done at a client's site. It covers jobs with client, site, request date and urgency, parts and labour lines, the steps draft, scheduled, in progress, done and invoiced, completion reports as plain text or A4 PDF, invoice line items with VAT at the shared business profile rate, and a summary of all work orders. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier allows 5 open work orders; PDF completion reports, invoice items and the summary need Pro.
catalogue: A product and labour price catalogue. It covers SKUs with unit, VAT rate and dated prices per currency and tier, hourly labour rates by role, the price in force on any date, quote and invoice lines priced from the catalogue, and price lists under the business name. Prices are whole minor units and a new price keeps the earlier rows. The catalogue is stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier holds 25 SKUs in one tier; the print-ready price list and catalogue summary need Pro.
change-order: Change orders against quotes and work orders. It covers change orders with added, removed or changed lines and reasons, the steps draft, sent, approved, rejected or void, the running contract value with approved and pending changes kept apart, client approval documents, and invoice or quote line items for approved changes with VAT at the shared business profile rate. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier allows 5 open change orders; approval documents and invoice items need Pro.
bill-of-sale: Bills of sale for selling items such as vehicles, equipment or phones. It covers seller, buyer, item details with VIN, serial or IMEI, price, as-is clause and warranty, editable drafts, finalized signing copies, printable Markdown or HTML documents with signature lines and a DRAFT watermark on drafts, and totals sold per currency. Documents are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service, and files come back as one-hour download links. The free tier holds 10 drafts and 5 finalized documents.
job-card: Job cards for crews doing on-site work. It covers cards with client, site, job and schedule, labour hours by worker and materials used, the steps open, in progress, done, invoiced and archived, printable cards with a client signature line, and daily or weekly hours and value. Values are integer cents fixed when logged and kept per currency. Cards are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier holds 10 active cards; archiving a finished job frees a slot.
dunning-letters: Chasing unpaid invoices with a three-letter escalation ladder. It covers registering unpaid invoices with amount and due date, part or full payments, reminder, firm reminder and final notice letters as Markdown or printable HTML, the dates letters went out, the day's chase list, invoices past due and the ageing of what is owed. Letters are drafted here and never sent; sending is the user's act. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier chases 3 invoices at once.
checklist: Reusable checklists with signed-off runs. It covers checklists with required and optional steps grouped in sections, dated runs that copy the steps so later edits never change a run under way, pass, fail or not-applicable answers with who and when, sign-off that freezes a run and keeps exceptions on record, and plain-text run reports. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier holds 3 checklists with unlimited runs; Pro also returns run reports as download files.
packing-list: Packing lists for outgoing shipments. It covers lists opened against an order, the ordered lines, cartons with tare weight and dimensions, packed and unpacked items, gross, volumetric and chargeable weight, shortfalls and over-packing against the order, shipping with carrier and tracking number, and packing slips without prices. Weights are whole grams and dimensions whole centimetres. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier allows 3 open lists; Pro also returns slips as download files.
delivery-schedule: Delivery schedules for client work under a quote, work order or change order. It covers dated deliverables with net values, the steps planned, in progress, delivered and accepted, what is late at a date with the value at risk, client schedule documents with a sign-off block, and invoice or quote line items for accepted milestones with VAT at the shared business profile rate. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier allows 3 open schedules; documents and milestone invoice items need Pro.
supplier-list: A supplier directory. It covers supplier records with category, contacts, payment terms, lead time and notes, updates and removals, review stamps, records not reviewed within a set number of days, and exports as CSV or a Markdown table. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier holds 10 suppliers; the stale-record review and Markdown export need Pro.
service-agreement: Service agreements between a freelancer and a client. It covers parties, scope, deliverables, rate and payment terms, dates, termination notice, liability cap and jurisdiction, the steps draft, sent, signed and expired, a built-in set of optional clauses (IP assignment, confidentiality, late payment interest, kill fee, revision rounds), Markdown or HTML documents with signature blocks, and a pre-send check of missing fields and terms. Agreements are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier holds 3 active agreements; full clause texts and HTML need Pro.
maintenance-log: Equipment maintenance records. It covers a register of equipment with serial or asset tag and location, work done with date, cost, who did it and when the next service is due, each asset's full history and total spend, what is overdue or coming due, and exports as CSV or Markdown. Costs are integer cents. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier holds 3 assets with unmetered logging; the due-date view and Markdown export need Pro.
mileage-log: A mileage log for tax and expense claims. It covers drives with date, route, distance in miles or km, purpose and category (business, medical, moving, charitable, personal), user-set rates per jurisdiction and category by effective date, deductible totals for a date range, and CSV exports for an accountant. No rates ship with the server; the figures are the user's to verify. Trips are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier logs 20 trips a month and one rate per jurisdiction and category; CSV export needs Pro.
goods-receipt: Goods receipt against purchase orders. It covers purchase orders with SKU lines, ordered quantities and over and under tolerances, goods-receipt notes for full or partial deliveries with damaged and short units, discrepancies, closed receipt notes, and the status of every order against its receipts. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. Receiving is on the free tier; CSV export needs Pro.
onboarding: New hire onboarding plans. It covers hires with role and start date, tasks owned by HR, the manager or IT with due dates counted from the start date, role templates copied into each hire's plan, tasks done or skipped, each hire's progress, and tasks past their due date across all hires. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. A template applies to one hire on the free tier; applying it to many hires and CSV export need Pro.
leave: Employee leave and PTO tracking. It covers employees with annual allowance and carried-over days, vacation, sick, unpaid and parental requests including half days, approval, rejection and cancellation, balances, who is out in a date range, and conflict checks between requests. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. Employees and requests are unlimited on the free tier; bulk CSV import and .ics calendar export of approved leave need Pro.
purchase-requisition: Purchase requisitions handled as reusable step lists with sign-off. It covers requisitions with required and optional steps grouped in sections, dated runs that copy the steps so later edits never change a run under way, pass, fail or not-applicable answers with who and when, sign-off that freezes a run and keeps exceptions on record, and plain-text run reports. Records are stored per user account on McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier holds 3 requisitions with unlimited runs; Pro also writes run reports to files.
backlink-checker: Backlink verification for SEO and link outreach. It covers whether a referring page links to a target domain, with dofollow or nofollow status and anchor text, audits of backlink lists, a page's outbound links, a referring domain's status including unlinked brand mentions, which outreach sites added a promised link, and noindex and nofollow robots signals. Pages are fetched live from the public web by McpStamp's hosted service. The free tier audits 3 URLs per request.
